description: Lists a client's AI Motion assessments, newest first, with overall score, rep accuracy and reps, plus a 180-day summary. Use when the user asks how a client's form or assessment scores are trending. Not for regular workout sessions (use list_client_sessions). Returns assessment IDs, workout names, dates, scores and paging.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

from_date.description: Only assessments on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

to_date.description: Only assessments before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

workout_id.description: Only assessments of this workout, to see its trend. Get it from list_team_workouts, e.g. "6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0". Omits the summary.

name: list_client_assessments
title: List client assessments
